32:12.text: And if you only could see when the Mujrimûn
shall hang their heads before their Lord
: "Our Lord! We have now seen and heard, so send us back
, that we will do righteous good deeds. Verily! We now believe with certainty."

32:13.text: And if We had willed, surely We would have given every person his guidance, but the Word from Me took effect
, that I will fill Hell with jinn and mankind together.

32:14.text: because of your forgetting the Meeting of this Day of yours. Surely We too will forget you: so taste you the abiding torment for what you used to do.

32:15.text: Only those believe in Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
, who, when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrate, and glorify the Praises of their Lord, and they are not proud.

32:16.text: Their sides forsake their beds, to invoke their Lord in fear and hope, and they spend
out of what We have bestowed on them.

32:17.text: No person knows what is kept hidden for them of joy as a reward for what they used to do.

32:18.text: Is then he who is a believer like him who is a Fâsiq

32:19.text: (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
and do righteous good deeds, for them are Gardens
as an entertainment for what they used to do.

32:20.text: And as for those who are Fâsiqûn
, their abode will be the Fire, every time they wish to get away therefrom, they will be put back thereto, and it will be said to them: "Taste you the torment of the Fire which you used to deny."
